title: Low-res density grid from particles (reuse VolumeRenderer path)
purpose: Generate a coarse 3D density grid (e.g., 96^3–128^3) from particle positions to support iso-surface shell extraction for RT self-shadowing.

steps.detail: Create a 3D R16_SFLOAT density image with mip chain and views (GENERAL for compute, SAMPLED for reads).
Add/repurpose a compute pass to splat particles into the grid (Gaussian or box) using atomic adds; clear base mip at frame start.
Generate mip chain (vkCmdBlitImage or compute). Use Sync2 barriers between passes; no transitions inside dynamic rendering.
Fit grid bounds tightly around current particle AABB; log origin/extent.

acceptance: Density grid updated per frame; average density > 0 when particles present
No validation errors; correct transitions GENERAL↔SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('3D image layouts and barriers with Synchronization2')
notes: Keep resolution modest for speed; this grid is for shell extraction, not final volume rendering.
